core.name: Core-51

interpretation: Core-51, Extended and Global are overlapping eligibility sets. A country in Core remains in the published locked benchmark; it is not recalibrated by appearing in a broader tier.

ARE.note: The published Core-51 is immutable. This check reports wider-tier eligibility only and never adds the country to Core retrospectively.
